snippet_primary: "I purchased a piece of wall art on Etsy that stated a 14 day return window so I felt it was safe to order the product. Upon opening the product, I immediately knew it was poor quality and did not appear as the Etsy photo. I immediately placed it back in the box and contacted the seller for return. After a few correspondence and her trying to talk me into keeping it, I stood firm and reminded her of the return policy as stated on the website. She then gave me her return address. It was in the county of Turkey, I was not aware if this prior to purchase or I would have never bought it. I took it up to UPS to get a price to send it back and it was over $1100.00."
subject_exact: ConsumerAffairs reviewer (2025) received low-quality Etsy wall art; seller's return address was in Turkey; international return shipping quoted over $1,100 at UPS, making the stated 14-day return policy effectively cost-prohibitive
